data.content_ref: inline:The covering principle is a lattice-duality: every admissible enrichment (SRC_005, SRC_011) is an endofunctor on the poset of attack graphs that is monotone with respect to edge-inclusion, and the grounded labeling is the least fixed point. The four foundation artifacts (SRC_002 defense-witness, SRC_004 fragility, SRC_003/SRC_008 suspend-reason) are all instances of a single derived diagnostic functor D: G ↦ (G, annotations) whose annotations are natural transformations computed from the final labeling, never from the fixpoint. REFUTED IF there exists an admissible enrichment satisfying the neighborhood's polynomial/monotone constraints whose derived annotations cannot be expressed as a natural transformation over the final labeling, or if the grounded labeling of the enriched graph is not the least fixed point of the monotone operator.
